correctness.rationale: The adjacent ratio p_{k+1}/p_k=(n-k)(alpha+k)/[(k+1)(beta+n-k-1)] is exact. Writing u=alpha−1, v=beta−1, clearing positive denominators shows r_{k-1}−r_k has numerator (n-k)(n-k+1)u+k(k+1)v+(n+1)uv. With u>0>v this decreases strictly in k, so nonnegative curvature is equivalent to its value at k=n−1, yielding threshold u>=n(n−1)(−v)/(2+(n+1)v) and strict denominator requirement. Reflection handles v>0>u; u,v>=0 gives all curvatures nonnegative. For u,v<0, setting a=−u,b=−v∈(0,1) bounds numerator by −ab(F+G−n−1)<0. Independently simplified the ratio-difference identity symbolically and read the all-rational n=2..31 verifier including explicit n=3 equality and n=4 failure; finite grid alone does not certify real continuum.
